svg.title: The seeds were cooked!
svg.desc: Paper-cut scene: the old emperor beams and lifts Ping's empty blue-and-white pot up high. A thought bubble beside him shows a cooking pot steaming over a little fire with seeds tumbling in: the seeds he gave out had been cooked. Ping, beside him, looks up with his mouth open in surprise, and so do a girl in pink and a boy in orange standing behind their flower pots.
